items.name: Venue Space Rental & Access Permit
items.assumption: Hall / private dining room / venue rental with tables & chairs (~USD 274).
items.notes: Confirm standard duration, load-in time, and trash disposal policies.

items.name: Catering, Meals & Refreshments
items.assumption: USD 17.37/guest x 35 guests (main fare, appetizers & refreshments).
items.notes: Includes accommodations for dietary requirements (vegetarian, allergies).

items.name: Celebration Cake & Specialty Desserts
items.assumption: Custom celebration cake or dessert buffet (~USD 122).
items.notes: Tiered cake or cupcakes with custom theme toppers.

items.name: Atmosphere Decor, Centerpieces & Backdrops
items.assumption: Floral arrangements and themed backdrops with thematic accents (~USD 182).
items.notes: Palette coordinated with event theme and atmospheric lighting.

items.name: Sound, Music & Interactive Entertainment
items.assumption: Sound system / DJ playlist / interactive group party games (~USD 152).
items.notes: Custom curated playlist or live performer/entertainer.

items.name: Photography & Memory Keepsakes
items.assumption: Event photographer or Polaroid instant memory station (~USD 61).

items.name: Invitations, Stationery & Guest Favors
items.assumption: Digital RSVP stationery & departure party favors (~USD 46).
items.notes: Custom designed digital invitations and token guest favors.

items.name: Contingency Reserve & Unforeseen Needs
items.assumption: Safety buffer allocated at 5% of total budget.
items.notes: Reserved for unexpected last-minute additions, delivery fees, or gratuity.

assumptions: Catering is estimated at USD 17.37 per person.
Costs are calculated transparently and can be edited anytime.

timeline.title: Venue Access & Setup Phase
timeline.description: Host and setup team arrive. Arrange tables, place settings, balloon arches, and backdrop.

timeline.title: Audio & Vendor Readiness Check
timeline.description: Test sound system, verify catering arrival, chill beverages, and light decorative candles.

timeline.title: Guest Arrival & Welcome Refreshments
timeline.description: Welcome guests at entrance, direct to coat area/guestbook, serve welcome drinks and light canapés.

timeline.title: Opening Welcome & Social Mingling
timeline.description: Warm welcome toast by the host, introductory group activities or photo-booth photo rounds.

timeline.title: Main Meal & Catering Service
timeline.description: Buffet, plated dinner or party food stations open. Accommodate special dietary preferences.

timeline.title: Celebration Highlight, Cake Cutting & Speeches
timeline.description: Gather all guests around the centerpiece. Deliver heartwarming toasts and cut the celebration cake.

timeline.title: High-Energy Music, Dancing & Games
timeline.description: Curated playlist, group games, open dance floor, or guest mingling with desserts and coffee.

timeline.title: Farewell Remarks & Favor Distribution
timeline.description: Host thanks guests for coming, distribute celebration favors and keepsake photo prints.

timeline.title: Cleanup & Venue Handover
timeline.description: Pack up personal decor, collect gifts, clear trash, and complete venue inspection with manager.

checklist.task: Finalize guest list and confirm maximum capacity with venue
checklist.notes: Ensure room for seated dining and active zones.

checklist.task: Book indoor venue space and confirm reservation deposit
checklist.notes: Ask for access hours, power outlets, and cleanup rules.

checklist.task: Design and dispatch digital or printed celebration invitations
checklist.notes: Include RSVP deadline (at least 2 weeks before event) and dietary prompt.

checklist.task: Review catering menu options and accommodate dietary preferences
checklist.notes: Confirm vegetarian, vegan, and allergy safety accommodations.

checklist.task: Order celebration centerpiece cake and dessert assortments
checklist.notes: Specify theme design, cake flavors, and pickup/delivery window.

checklist.task: Curate celebration music playlist or confirm performer/DJ details
checklist.notes: Select arrival, dining, toast, and high-energy dance tracks.

checklist.task: Audit RSVPs and compile final headcount & seating chart
checklist.notes: Directly follow up with any outstanding pending invitees.

checklist.task: Purchase themed decorations, table runners, and lighting supplies
checklist.notes: Match atmosphere 'festive and joyful' and color accents.

checklist.task: Send final guaranteed attendance number to catering team
checklist.notes: Prevent food shortage or costly over-ordering.

checklist.task: Assemble guest favor bags, photo props, and print schedule notes
checklist.notes: Designate a secure storage box for event transport.

checklist.task: Pack celebration emergency kit (scissors, tape, chargers, safety pins)
checklist.notes: Essential for quick troubleshooting on event day.

checklist.task: Execute event day timeline: supervise setup, welcome guests, enjoy!
checklist.notes: Assign trusted co-host to help manage timings.

recommendations.title: Future Bright & Academy Midnight
recommendations.description: Navy blue, metallic gold/silver, custom milestone banners, and graduation cap photo elements.
recommendations.reason: Proudly celebrates academic achievement with vibrant energy and plenty of photo-ready corners.

recommendations.title: Interactive Food Stations / Hot Buffet
recommendations.description: Two warm entrée selections (e.g., roasted chicken breast and artisan pasta) accompanied by fresh seasonal salads and signature mocktail/cocktail.
recommendations.reason: At USD 45.7/guest, buffet service delivers hot, substantial meals while allowing easy accommodation of dietary preferences.

recommendations.title: Statement Welcome Arch & Coordinated Tablescapes
recommendations.description: Professional floral arch, custom laser-cut name sign, satin table runners, and low-profile floral centerpieces.
recommendations.reason: Creates an unforgettable first impression as guests enter the venue, with zero setup stress on event morning.

recommendations.title: Curated Memory Timeline & Crowd-Pleaser Music
recommendations.description: Interactive Polaroid guestbook with personalized notes, custom celebration trivia, and a transition to high-energy dance floor.
recommendations.reason: Builds emotional connection and creates lasting tangible mementos of the celebration.
